newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar recovers at close to end flat.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar recovers at close to end flat.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar recovered to close at opening levels around C$1.3692 (US$0.7303) on Tuesday after stop-loss buying appeared at weak levels near C$1.3708 (US$0.7295) in late afternoon trading, dealers said.
* They said a rising U.S. dollar was pressuring the Canada in the face of speculation about higher U.S. rates.
As a result, the Canadian dollar weakened against the U.S. dollar, but followed the big dollar stronger against the other major currencies.

On the crosses, Canada's dollar rose to 1.2510 marks from Monday's close of 1.2353 marks and climbed to 89.13 yen from 87.95 yen. ((Paul Casciato, Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100 or email: paul.casciato@reuters.com))
